تستغفلي (form X)
# تَسْتَغْفِلِي (tastaḡfilī) /tas.taɣ.fi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# تُسْتَغْفَلِي (tustaḡfalī) /tus.taɣ.fa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
